questions.question: Explain two reasons why a consumer may not aim to maximise utility. (4 marks)
Explain two causes of a rightward shift in the demand curve for electric vehicles. (4 marks)
Draw a demand diagram to show the effect on the market for coach travel of a fall in the price of air travel on the same route. (4 marks)
Define the term 'price elasticity of demand' (PED). (2 marks)

The demand schedule in this chapter's diagram gives Tafari's daily ticket sales at each fare. Using the $20 and $22 rows — 400 tickets and 320 tickets — calculate the price elasticity of demand and state what it shows. (4 marks)
Analyse two factors that influence the price elasticity of demand for a branded soft drink. (6 marks)

Read the $10 and $12 rows off the demand schedule in this chapter's diagram — 800 tickets a day and 720 a day. Calculate total revenue at each fare and state which fare a revenue-maximising operator should choose. (4 marks)
Examine the significance of income elasticity of demand for a supermarket group planning for a period of falling real incomes. (8 marks)
Evaluate whether a government should place an indirect tax on a good with price inelastic demand. (20 marks)
